title: Training Note — Reinvestment Points on Class H Preferred Stock Redemptions, Member Equities & Patronage
content:
A Member Equities & Patronage Class H Preferred Stock holding that has reinvested its dividends earns redemption reinvestment points, so that more of it may be redeemed in a quarter.

## The rule

Redemption reinvestment points rest on the holding's reinvestment record: a holding carrying at least 16 reinvested dividend entries earns 10 points; a holding carrying at least 8 but fewer than 16 earns 5 points; a holding with fewer earns none.

The points are percentage points added to the share of the redemption allowance base the quarter allows for redemption on the holding, before that share is applied to the base.

## Questions answered

**What is counted?** The reinvested dividend entries on the holding — each quarterly dividend booked as reinvested in additional shares — over the whole life of the holding.

**A holding has 15 reinvested dividend entries. What does it earn?** 5 points; it needs 16 for 10 points.

**And with 7 entries?** None; 8 are needed for 5 points.

## Ladder

| Reinvested dividend entries on the holding | Points |
|---|---|
| 16 or more | 10 |
| 8 to 15 | 5 |
| 0 to 7 | None |
